declared.protocol: 64 output bytes, at most 65 predictions; the last call only checks EOS
declared.generation_groups: 6 targets x {real records, no records, domain-permuted records}
declared.read_groups: 5 descriptors x {real mapping, domain-permuted mapping, reversed records}
declared.action_exact: strict equality after stripping leading/trailing whitespace and terminal punctuation
declared.legacy_ordered_hit: object before place anywhere in the display text; not a gate
declared.generation_gate: real and permuted completed_action_exact both >=5 -> supported; both <=2 -> absent
declared.read_gate: real and permuted target top-1 (null included, ties<=1e-12 wrong) both >=4 -> supported; both <=1 -> absent

identity.read_state_origin: restored bundle state (same H used by 10.21a); generation uses isolated zero-H/F copies
